profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at CAT Digital
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with experience in all phases of the software lifecycle. Background includes driving requirements and architecture, testing and implementing software with an emphasis on customer needs. Strong team player with a proven ability to lead successful software teams. Committed to high quality deliverables to support business goals.

Specialties: 

Platform: 
Mac OS X, Windows, UNIX

Languages: 
Java, C , C++, Python, Oracle SQL/PL

Software:  
Eclipse for Java, Ant, Rational DOORS, Accurev, GIT, ClearCase, ClearQuest and Rose, Mac Pages, MS Office, Adobe FrameMaker and Acrobat Professional, Wireshark Network Analyzer and various other Internet tools

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Acquired by Microsoft.

Continued my role as Senior Engineer and played major role in supporting new Nokia devices with our Xpress Browser service.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Engineer responsible for leading a team that made significant contributions to Xpress Browser on Nokia Asha devices. Xpress Browser is a web browser service that provides cost saving to end users in emerging markets.  The system has roughly 100 million active users over a 30 day period and on a daily basis roughly 18 million users make use of the service.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - WiMAX ASN-Gateway
positions.description: Software Architect in the Call Processing team responsible for authoring Requirements, defining high and low level designs for features and enhancements for the Access Services Network Gateway (ASN-GW).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - VSX Systems Engineering
positions.description: Software Architect responsible for authoring requirements for two CDMA Network elements, the Selection and Distribution Unit (SDU) and the Vocoder Processing Unit (VPU).

positions.title: Software Engineer - Network Advanced Technologies
positions.description: Software developer responsible for implementing, integrating and testing experimental software.

positions.title: Software Engineer - High Availability Platform Group
positions.description: Software developer responsible for implementing, integrating and testing a high availability platform for CDMA network infrastructure.
